schemes.name: Child Trust Fund
schemes.gives: Your own tax-free savings account, opened by the government when you were born. Many are still unclaimed.
schemes.how: Ask HMRC's free tool where it was opened. Never pay a company to find it.

rule.fail: Born outside the Child Trust Fund years

schemes.name: Your child's Child Trust Fund
schemes.gives: A tax-free savings account the government opened for your child. You can add to it and find where it is.
schemes.how: Ask HMRC's free tool where it was opened. It's free, so never pay a finder company.

rule.expr: youngest child born between September 2002 and January 2011
rule.txt: A child born between September 2002 and January 2011
rule.fail: Youngest child born outside the Child Trust Fund years
